Subject: Santigen brand & logo usage — marketing permission and scope

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We loved the conversation and would like to feature Santigen in a short customer snapshot on our website and in an upcoming product announcement email. Specifically we want to: 

- Use the Santigen logo (color and mono versions) on a ‘Customers’ panel on our site.
- Publish a short quote (one sentence) from your VP of Data on latency/cost improvements.
- Include a one-paragraph case summary in a gated marketing asset (PDF).

Attached is a one-pager mock (redwood_one-pager.pdf) and a draft quote (redwood-draft-quote.txt) for your review. Can you confirm:

1) Whether Santigen is comfortable with logo + quote usage?
2) Any restrictions (e.g., no paid ads, geographic limits)?
3) Preferred logo files and a contact for legal sign-off (if required)?

If you’re okay, we can send a short permission form for signature. We aim to publish the snapshot the week of Nov 29.

Appreciate it — I’ve cc’d Marissa from marketing so she can coordinate designs.

Best,
Hannah

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear outline. Santigen is generally happy to be featured — we just need to confirm the exact scope. Quick answers below: 

1) High-level: OK to use logo and a short quote on your website (Customers page) and in a single email announcement.
2) Restrictions: Please do not use our logo in paid advertising or in partner co-branded events without additional approval. Also, no use that implies product endorsement or claims beyond the provided quote.
3) Legal contact: cc'd Tom Lang (Legal). He will confirm final sign-off and return a signed permission form.

I'll upload our brand pack (logo versions + usage PDFs) to the shared drive; Tom will follow up with any contractual language.

Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. I reviewed the ask and drafted a short permission form. Main points / redlines: 

- Scope: explicit permission for logo use on website (Customers page), marketing emails, and in the PDF case study only.
- Prohibition: no paid advertising, no use implying product endorsement beyond the provided quote.
- Attribution: Santigen must be identified by company name only; do not assert endorsements or specific performance numbers unless Santigen signs off on those figures.
- Retention: Redwood may keep copies of the signed form and usage evidence for up to 3 years for audit/compliance purposes.

I recommend we send the attached short permission PDF via DocuSign. Tom at Santigen can sign electronically. I also added a clause to allow Santigen to review and request a final pre-publish proof.

I attached: permission_template_santigen.pdf (redlines in comments). Once you confirm, I'll produce the final PDF and generate the DocuSign envelope.
